snippet.title: Bubsy: Less Bad Edition - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a fanmade project!

This is romhack for the SNES version of Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind. I changed the game in a way that, under my personal criteria, makes the game more fair and entertaining. This is also an experiment to see if, after fixing or tweaking some of the most frustrating stuff, there's something in the core game that makes it still worth playing. That's up to you to decide.

How to play? You can find the Find IPS patch the instructions and the full list of changes here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YJr-QvwGXAt_13fy8thxDtzx1hNb8FA6?usp=sharing

Feel free to reach to me if you have questions or can't make it work. Enjoy!

DISCLAIMERS:

- I don't have the capacity to romhack other bubsy games or versions of this one, I'm afraid you won't get a Genesis version from me... If somebody else wants to take the challenge, that would be amazing.

- I won't say Bubsy's weird physics are necessarily good, but I consider them a big part of the game's platforming identity. I believe it's rewarding to learn them and take advantage of them to perform cool tricks and combos when mastered, specially combined with the gliding. I know many of you are asking for it but I don't think I will make any big changes to it.

- I love listening and considering your feedback and suggestions, but please understand that I cannot commit to fulfilling specific requests. This is a passion project I work on in my spare time, so updates will depend on my availability and personal vision for the mod.
